mapper.sql: select t.id, t.shop_code, t.stocktake_code, t.ware_code, t.ware_name, t.scope, t.status, t.line_count, t.diff_count, t.gain_qty, t.gain_amount, t.loss_qty, t.loss_amount, t.adjust_doc_codes, t.adjust_table_suffix, t.remark, t.reject_reason, t.create_user, t.create_time, t.submit_user, t.submit_time, t.confirm_user, t.confirm_time, t.update_time from sdsshop.u_m_stocktake t
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_stocktake (shop_code, stocktake_code, ware_code, ware_name, scope, status, line_count, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time) values (#{shopCode}, #{stocktakeCode}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, #{scope}, #{status}, #{lineCount}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_stocktake set status = '已完成', diff_count = #{diffCount}, gain_qty = #{gainQty}, gain_amount = #{gainAmount}, loss_qty = #{lossQty}, loss_amount = #{lossAmount}, adjust_doc_codes = #{adjustDocCodes}, adjust_table_suffix = #{adjustTableSuffix}, confirm_user = #{confirmUser}, confirm_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and stocktake_code = #{stocktakeCode} and status = '待审核'
mapper.select: select i.id, i.shop_code, i.stocktake_code, i.goods_code, i.goods_name, i.spec, i.unit, i.qualityflag, i.book_qty, i.counted_qty, i.diff_qty, i.cost_price, i.diff_amount, i.batch_code, i.serial_nos, i.remark, g.batchstrategy, g.costcalculation, coalesce(s.physicalqty, 0) as current_qty, coalesce(s.lockedqty, 0) as locked_qty from sdsshop.u_m_stocktake_item i join sdsshop.u_m_stocktake t on t.shop_code = i.shop_code and t.stocktake_code = i.stocktake_code left join sdsshop.u_m_waregoods g on g.shop_code = i.shop_code and g.goodscode = i.goods_code left join sdsshop.u_m_stock s on s.shop_code = i.shop_code and s.goodscode = i.goods_code and s.warecode = t.ware_code and s.qualityflag = i.qualityflag and s.onhandflag = 1 where i.shop_code = #{shopCode} and i.stocktake_code = #{stocktakeCode} order by i.goods_code, i.qualityflag desc
mapper.insert:
insert into sdsshop.u_m_stocktake_item (shop_code, stocktake_code, goods_code, goods_name, spec, unit, qualityflag, book_qty, counted_qty, cost_price, update_time) values
(#{it.shopCode}, #{it.stocktakeCode}, #{it.goodsCode}, #{it.goodsName}, #{it.spec}, #{it.unit}, #{it.qualityFlag}, #{it.bookQty}, #{it.countedQty}, #{it.costPrice}, sysdate())
